purpose: Only the two special short-path article types that need extra rules.
global_rules: Use only the central calculator placeholder; never embed widget HTML.
No invented prices, rates, savings or superlatives.
Title contains the concrete topic, not provider or calculator names.
Articles in the same batch must not use a fixed wording/template series.

TARIFRECHNER_VERSICHERUNG.before_calculator: Explain the relevant protection, benefits and selection points.
TARIFRECHNER_VERSICHERUNG.after_calculator: Briefly explain result, benefits, exclusions and conditions.

TARIFRECHNER_KOSTEN.use_for: Higher-priced purchases or construction measures where financing is genuinely relevant.
TARIFRECHNER_KOSTEN.before_calculator: Explain budget, own funds, term, rate and total cost without inventing numbers.
TARIFRECHNER_KOSTEN.after_calculator: Briefly explain rate, term, effective interest and total amount.
